_about: Sizing-model mass calibration to the iteration-1 CAD (WP G) + FEA (WP F) masses after the iteration-2 weight reductions. Generated by sizing/calibration.py; read by sizing/model.py and sizing/design_out.py.

factor_basis.boom_tube: on the strength-sized raw tube mass (replaces the x1.25 sleeve factor): includes WP F over-wrap segments, +-45 layers, sleeves, bands and end caps
factor_basis.landing_gear: on the raw strength-sized skid/cross-tube mass (replaces x1.6): includes the oleo dampers (80 mm stroke), collars, saddles P4, clamps, fairings and shoes
factor_basis.avionics: on Raymer [M12]: tray, panel and lumped wiring as modelled

fixed_basis.rotor_station_hardware_each: pylon tube, pylon saddle with socket, pylon head, motor plate P3, elastomeric isolators, nacelle fairing (per rotor station, after reductions)
fixed_basis.parachute_installation: cradle, front and rear riser hard points P5 with angles
fixed_basis.pusher_installation: motor plate, strut end fittings, pultruded struts, spinner
fixed_basis.seats_and_furnishings: 2 crash-rated seats (shell, cushion, EA block, rails, P6 fittings, harness anchors, harnesses) + furnishings

battery.basis: CAD packs (boxes, lids, 4 cold plates, G10 holders, BMS, contactors, mounts) + estimated nickel, liners, BMS harness give 0.22; 0.25 adopted (= WP M light scenario) for the packs to be reshaped

W-CORE-1.justification: wing XPS cores: hot-wire-cut spanwise lightening voids, 30 mm of foam kept under each skin and full foam at the ribs, spar box and control-surface hinge lines; the skins are stabilised by the 30 mm layer (same practice as hollow-core moldless wings); WP F to re-check skin wrinkling and core shear

W-SPM-F.justification: main-spar box foam Divinycell H80 -> H45 (45/80 of the mass); the box webs carry the shear, the foam only stabilises them; WP F to re-check web buckling

MP.justification: motor plate P3: FEA MS +2.8 (stress 26 % of allowable) -> pocket the plate between the bolt circles

PY-C.justification: pylon saddle with socket: pocket the side walls and the socket outside the clamp/bolt bosses

PY-HEAD.justification: pylon head: pocket between the isolator bosses

LG-SADDLE.justification: gear saddle P4 (MS +0.41 at the 3 g rigid-gear load): with the oleo dampers the limit gear load drops to ~2.3 W (WP F) -> 20 % thinner pad/wall, to be confirmed by WP F with the damper load

CH-CRADLE.justification: parachute cradle: open truss/pocketed cradle instead of a solid machined block

TL-CLAMP.justification: tail clamps: pocket outside the spar sockets
